notes: Rotondo's pinned Shark remains a partial native port. The generic importer now retains its 3.5-by-3.5-by-1.8 native collision dimensions (the raw PlayerData boundingBox is quartered), density/drag and authored mouth mount nodes; the renderer uses its own swim sequence in water. Its companion chooses among the source palette, including floating/sinking helper archetypes and the rare or named Cool Shark, hides its hole, and models a physically gated mouth capture followed by ordinary attributed damage after five seconds. Capture release revalidates mount identity, life, MiniGame membership and damage permission, and handles death, spawn, leave and game/reset hooks. Only this package's own bot kinds may act as holders; body identity still classifies eligible victims. The source zeros native speeds, so chosen water speeds remain 10/5/8 and land speeds 2/1/1. Main swimming, 35-damage fallback bite and nine-second out-of-water death remain. Headless integration verified ordinary approach, authored mount2 alignment, a five-second capture kill and canonical credit with the refreshed original body; broader visual and interactive acceptance remains with Maxwell. Remaining deviations: capture temporarily rests the holder instead of the original flee loop; no two-second restart delay, forced vehicle ejection, source infection, full white-shark aggression/no-strafe policy or original SharkHoleBite death icon. Helper archetypes change buoyancy but are not additional spawn kinds. No universal creature policy is claimed.
